title: The gym-owner site, the member site and every gym web page load their letters from Google, but the privacy notice says our websites send nothing out
what: Each visit to gyms.mettleup.fit, mettleup.fit or a gym's own web page makes the visitor's browser fetch fonts from Google, so Google gets the visitor's internet address, browser and the page they came from. The privacy notice says our websites use no analytics, and its list of companies names Google only for sign-in, pop-ups, Play, the member-list import and old Drive backups. A visitor is never told. Under EU and UK rules, which the notice says it follows, sending the address to Google this way without telling people has been ruled unlawful.
expected: Website visitors are told every outside company their visit reaches, or the pages carry their own fonts so nothing goes to Google.
who: every visitor to the websites and gym web pages
fix_line: Serve the fonts from our own site (no Google call), or name Google for website fonts in the privacy notice in both languages.

title: The delete-account page says nothing is on our server unless you used Continue with Google, but joining a gym or signing in with a phone number puts data there
what: The page Google Play links to for account deletion says you only have an account if you tapped Continue with Google, and that otherwise nothing is saved on our server and there is nothing to delete. The privacy notice repeats it for EU and UK readers. But a member who only joined a gym with its code has their name, leaderboard numbers, trainer summary, machine use and pop-up code on the server, and phone-number sign-in (added 15 Nov) does not need Google at all. The email route also only works from the Google email address, so such a member is told there is nothing to ask for and has no way to ask. The page was last changed on 10 Nov, before phone sign-in.
expected: The delete-account page and the privacy notice say what a member who never used Google still has on the server (through their gym), how to remove it (leave the gym, or email us with their mobile number), and accept a mobile number as well as a Google email.
who: members who joined a gym or signed in with their number but never used Google
how_often: every such member who reads the page
fix_line: Rewrite the opening of the delete-account page and the matching privacy line to cover gym members and phone sign-in, and let them ask by mobile number.

title: The bring-a-friend page takes a stranger's name and number with no link to the privacy notice and no age line
what: A member's invite link opens a page where the friend types their name, mobile number and best time to train. The page says only that the gym sees the number. It has no link to any privacy notice, does not say who runs the page, how long the details are kept or how to have them removed, and asks nothing about age. The join-online form, by contrast, has an 18-or-older tick and a privacy link. The friend has never agreed to anything with MettleUp or the gym.
expected: The friend page says in one line who gets the details, for what, for how long and how to remove them, links the privacy notice, and says the offer is for people 18 or over, as the join-online form does.
who: friends of members who open an invite link
fix_line: Add a short notice line, a privacy link and an 18-or-over line to the friend invite page.

items.reason: 60 listed promises read against the code. Broken here: the delete-account page (pilot-33, pilot-34, legal-2-65) = finding 02. Others are already findings: every look recorded (legal-2-16, pilot-15) FN-A3-notes-claude-1-01 and FN-L4-server-database-3-05; support window and read-only (legal-2-13, 2-15, 2-46, pilot-12, pilot-14) FN-A5-server-database-1-3-01 and FN-A3-website-1-01; Gemini only for the import (pilot-05) FN-L4-hq-app-01; voice only to Groq (legal-2-10, 2-52) FN-L4-server-panel-worker-01; messages gone after 180 days (help-1-22) FN-A3-help-02; photos never leave the phone (legal-2-58) FN-A5-phone-screens-2-1b-01; gym deleted within 30 days (legal-2-28, 2-90, 3-28, pilot-23) FN-L4-hq-app-05 and FN-L4-hq-app-03; mobile erased on leaving (pilot-43) FN-A5-server-database-1-2-01; age 18 (legal-2-42, 2-67, 3-03) FN-L4-server-database-1-03 and finding 03. Owner re-accept of new terms (legal-3-31) has a version gate in the admin app. Member promises about the phone app, the 400-day AI log and the 2027 log rule are outside these folders and were not re-read.

Notice: website fonts reach Google untold (01); the friend page has no notice (03); the join-online form and gym web page are missing from the privacy notice (already FN-L4-server-database-3-02). Consent: join-online asks an 18-or-older tick plus a health tick and links the notice; the friend page asks nothing. Purpose: the demo form says the number is used only to call back and is kept 12 months unless a deal. Deletion: delete-account page wrong (02); gym delete leaves the second database (FN-L4-hq-app-05). Breach timing: these pages hold nothing for it (already FN-L4-server-hq-gate-workers-04). Children: friend page has no age line (03).

No page in this area shows gym records to MettleUp staff. The forms write to the gym's own records through server calls; the page Worker keeps only salted daily address hashes. Demo requests are read in HQ (logged, see L4-hq-app). The payment rows are read by the join page only by a secret request id. Gym-record looks by MettleUp are already FN-A3-notes-claude-1-01.

friend_asks (address hashes for friend, join-online and gym page limits): deleted after 2 days by the daily job, as listed. Demo requests: 12 months, but a won one is kept for ever (FN-L4-hq-app-04). Mobile numbers from join-online and page questions kept for ever (FN-L4-server-database-3-03). pay_requests and pay_gyms (join and fee payments: member id, amount, receipt number, gym UPI ID) have no clean-up at all and no line in the notice; they are the gym's records and go with FN-L4-hq-app-05 when the gym leaves. The gym page keeps its chat in the visitor's browser for 90 days.

Google gets every visitor's address through fonts (01). The gym page AI helper sends the visitor's chat to Anthropic, not named for this (already FN-L4-server-database-3-02). Join payments send the person's name and mobile to the gym's payment company, which the notice names. No analytics script: the security policy allows Cloudflare's visit counter, but the live gyms.mettleup.fit and mettleup.fit pages fetched today carry none, so no analytics holds. Maps are plain links, nothing embedded.

The public delete-account page misleads members without Google (02). Gym delete never touches the page Worker's own database: payment rows, the gym's UPI ID and its sealed payment-company keys stay after a gym is deleted (same cause as FN-L4-hq-app-05); its web page photos stay (FN-L4-hq-app-03). Friend links end when the member leaves or is deleted. Backups expire in 7 days as the page says.
